mapper.select: SELECT a.id as activity_id, a.title, u.nickname as organizer_name, a.created_at_and_signup_start_time, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, CASE WHEN a.created_at_and_signup_start_time < NOW() AND a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time > NOW() AND a.status != 'finished' THEN 'open' WHEN a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time < NOW() AND a.activity_end_time > NOW() AND a.status != 'finished' THEN 'inprogress' WHEN a.activity_end_time < NOW() OR a.status = 'finished' THEN 'finished' ELSE 'pending' END as computed_status, COALESCE(a.image_url, 'https://cdn.example.com/activities/default.jpg') as image_url, a.location, COALESCE(COUNT(ap.user_id), 0) as participant_count, a.max_participants FROM activities a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.organizer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN activity_participants ap ON a.id = ap.activity_id WHERE a.created_at_and_signup_start_time < NOW() AND a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time > NOW() AND a.status != 'finished' AND a.status = 'published' AND a.organizer_id = #{userId} GROUP BY a.id, a.title, u.nickname, a.created_at_and_signup_start_time, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, a.status, a.image_url, a.location, a.max_participants ORDER BY a.created_at_and_signup_start_time DESC

SELECT a.id as activity_id, a.title, u.nickname as organizer_name, a.created_at_and_signup_start_time, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, CASE WHEN a.created_at_and_signup_start_time < NOW() AND a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time > NOW() AND a.status != 'finished' THEN 'open' WHEN a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time < NOW() AND a.activity_end_time > NOW() AND a.status != 'finished' THEN 'inprogress' WHEN a.activity_end_time < NOW() OR a.status = 'finished' THEN 'finished' ELSE 'pending' END as computed_status, COALESCE(a.image_url, 'https://cdn.example.com/activities/default.jpg') as image_url, a.location, COALESCE(COUNT(ap.user_id), 0) as participant_count, a.max_participants FROM activities a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.organizer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN activity_participants ap ON a.id = ap.activity_id WHERE a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time < NOW() AND a.activity_end_time > NOW() AND a.status != 'finished' AND a.status = 'published' AND a.organizer_id = #{userId} GROUP BY a.id, a.title, u.nickname, a.created_at_and_signup_start_time, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, a.status, a.image_url, a.location, a.max_participants ORDER BY a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time DESC

SELECT a.id as activity_id, a.title, u.nickname as organizer_name, a.created_at_and_signup_start_time, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, 'finished' as computed_status, COALESCE(a.image_url, 'https://cdn.example.com/activities/default.jpg') as image_url, a.location, COALESCE(COUNT(ap.user_id), 0) as participant_count, a.max_participants FROM activities a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.organizer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN activity_participants ap ON a.id = ap.activity_id WHERE a.activity_end_time < NOW() OR a.status = 'finished' AND a.organizer_id = #{userId} GROUP BY a.id, a.title, u.nickname, a.created_at_and_signup_start_time, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, a.status, a.image_url, a.location, a.max_participants ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC

SELECT COALESCE(u.avatar, 'https://cdn.example.com/users/default-avatar.jpg') as avatar FROM activity_participants ap LEFT JOIN users u ON ap.user_id = u.id WHERE ap.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY ap.created_at DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT * FROM activities ORDER BY created_at_and_signup_start_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activities ( title, description, organizer_id, signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, activity_end_time, location, max_participants, status, image_url, created_at_and_signup_start_time ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{description}, #{organizerId}, #{signupEndTimeAndActivityStartTime}, #{activityEndTime}, #{location}, #{maxParticipants}, #{status}, #{imageUrl}, #{createdAtAndSignupStartTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE activities SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, organizer_id = #{organizerId}, signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time = #{signupEndTimeAndActivityStartTime}, activity_end_time = #{activityEndTime}, location = #{location}, max_participants = #{maxParticipants}, status = #{status}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
